index.</span><div><span style="font-size: 18px;"><br></span></div><div><ul><li><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;">Find the maximum length of the LIS that ends before the current index.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;">If maxLength == 0, start a new subsequence from the current index and update bit[].</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;">If maxLength &gt; 0.</span></li><ul><li><font style="font-size: 18px;">Increment maxLength by 1, and update bit[].</font></li></ul></ul></div>"
